:::{#sol-prereq-nested-loops}

The value is 15.
`range(5)` gives `i` the values 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4.
For each `i`,
`range(i, 5)` has $5 - i$ values,
so the inner loop runs 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 times.
The total is $5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15$.

An answer of 10 or 20 points to the ends of `range`:
`range(a, b)` includes `a` and excludes `b`.
Counting loop iterations with a sum like this one
starts the chapter [Recurrences and Growth](recurrences-growth.qmd).

:::
